name: Zimone Wola
description: Zimone Wola is a mathematical prodigy and Quandrix student of Strixhaven, granddaughter of Nimiroti, who survived Duskmourn and graduated into a fellowship on Ravnica.

summary.text: Zimone Wola is a mathematical prodigy and Quandrix student of Strixhaven, granddaughter of Nimiroti, who survived Duskmourn and graduated into a fellowship on Ravnica.

bio.text: Zimone received packages of blue-green ribbons from her grandmother Nimiroti for seven years and learned that Nimiroti had solved the Vorzani Conjecture and been captured by the Oriq.
She refused Extus's offer to share what the Oriq knew and lashed him and Pita into a wall with her ribbon braid.
Nimiroti no longer remembered Zimone when she visited her at the Sanctuary of the Lost.
During the Phyrexian invasion of Strixhaven, Zimone and Dina built a ritual that blasted a hole to open air and turned the Biblioplex's bookcases into a huge tree.

In Duskmourn she joined Kaito's team as a researcher, was separated with Tyvar in the House's library, and survived by hiding as part of the House and carrying Marina's diary, from which she deduced that Valgavoth had swallowed the outside.
Transformed into a splintered-wood figure, she cut Niko free and used Niv-Mizzet's box to trap a cultist, and the team then escaped to Ravnica.

Struggling after graduation, she divided herself into doubles to manage work and research on a shadow above Arcavios, then reintegrated them with Dina's help and traced the duplication of the Multiverse to Chandra Nalaar.

status.text: As of the latest story that features her she has graduated from Quandrix and begun a fellowship on Ravnica, with Primo as her summoned companion.

timeline.summary: Zimone waits in Firejolt Café counting bubbles on the last day of exams.
timeline.quote: Zimone Wola counts the clusters of bubbles floating in her glass of Kiwano Fizzy Pop.

timeline.summary: Zimone recalls Dean Kianne urging her to consider Quandrix.
timeline.quote: Please tell me you are considering Quandrix College for next year.

timeline.summary: The three friends have each chosen different colleges.
timeline.quote: Zimone chose Quandrix, Amaka Prismari, and Nnanyielugo Silverquill.

timeline.summary: Wallader tells Zimone a mystery package arrived for her two weeks ago.
timeline.quote: A package came in for you two weeks ago.

timeline.summary: Zimone realizes she knows who sent the package, one she has received for seven years.
timeline.quote: she has received the same package, just like the one Wallader described, for seven years now

timeline.summary: On her seventh birthday, Zimone received her first box of eight blue-green ribbons from her grandmother (flashback).
timeline.quote: Inside the velveteen-lined box were eight green-and-blue-striped ribbons and a note

timeline.summary: Zimone learns pieces of the story that her grandmother left Strixhaven after forgetting things and was never seen again (flashback).
timeline.quote: that she left Strixhaven and was never seen again

timeline.summary: Silverquill wins the Mage Tower game after hypnotizing Quandrix's captain.
timeline.quote: Silverquill College won even though one of their players hypnotized Quandrix College's captain at the finals.

timeline.summary: Zimone counts 377 ribbons and reads that this will be the last package.
timeline.quote: So, this will be the last one.

timeline.summary: Dean Imbraham teaches theory to second-year Quandrix mages.
timeline.quote: The most important thing you have to know about theory is that it is just substance we haven't figured out yet

timeline.summary: Imbraham tells Zimone she looks like her grandmother, whom he once taught.
timeline.quote: Your grandmother, Nimiroti Wola. Taught her in this same class many years ago.

timeline.summary: Imbraham praises Nimiroti as the best student he ever taught.
timeline.quote: The best student I've ever taught.

timeline.summary: Kianne tells Zimone her name is who she is.
timeline.quote: At this point, Zimone Wola is more than your name.

timeline.summary: Zimone takes out the Vorzani Conjecture book from the Biblioplex, last signed out by Nimiroti.
timeline.quote: Zimone had peeped into the record scroll as Isabough's branches reached to the farthest shelves to find the book.

timeline.summary: Zimone finds a note in her grandmother's handwriting hidden in the book.
timeline.quote: Packages of Ribbons. Numbers one step backward to go on forever. Living books that talk to you on the pathway of light.

timeline.summary: Zimone dreams of the Arithmodrome crumbling as she tries to save a woman braiding ribbons.
timeline.quote: Zimone races toward her to save her, because the Arithmodrome is crumbling.

timeline.summary: Kianne suspects Zimone and Imbraham of pursuing the Vorzani Conjecture and Zimone resists.
timeline.quote: Fear that I will find out what you and Dean Imbraham have been up to.

timeline.summary: The Codex Vocifera tells Zimone that Nimiroti solved the Vorzani Conjecture and was captured by the Oriq.
timeline.quote: Nimiroti figured out the Vorzani Conjecture.

timeline.summary: Zimone's ribbon braid weaves itself into patterns as she senses danger.
timeline.quote: The braid, as if it has a mind of its own, weaves into countless patterns.

timeline.summary: Zimone hits her head on a torch and loses consciousness.
timeline.quote: She spins to investigate but trips and slams her head against one of the torches.

timeline.summary: Zimone wakes to find Extus and Pita, who introduce themselves.
timeline.quote: My name is Extus

timeline.summary: Extus says they have followed Zimone for years and know about the packages.
timeline.quote: We have followed you for years.

timeline.summary: Extus offers to share what the Oriq knows about the Conjecture to control the universe.
timeline.quote: And we'll tell you what we know, and together, we can control the universe.

timeline.summary: Zimone refuses and lashes Extus and Pita into a wall with the ribbon braid.
timeline.quote: whips the braid of blue-green ribbons at the two men, sending them crashing into the wall at the far end of the room

timeline.summary: Pita argues Strixhaven hoards magic and that destroying it would spread magic to all.
timeline.quote: If we destroy it, then anyone anywhere in the world can practice magic.

timeline.summary: Kianne redirects Extus's fireball, and Zimone stops and douses it with her braid.
timeline.quote: Zimone swirls the braid of blue-green ribbons, weaving it into the tiny cracks of time and space

timeline.summary: Extus departs, saying they will meet again.
timeline.quote: Though I trust we'll meet again, Zimone Wola.

timeline.summary: Rumors spread that Zimone is an Oriq recruit and her friends avoid her.
timeline.quote: somehow, the rumor of her being an Oriq recruit spread around Strixhaven

timeline.summary: Zimone visits Nimiroti at the Sanctuary of the Lost and finds her braiding ribbons into her hair.
timeline.quote: Nimiroti is sitting beside the window with her back turned, braiding stripes of blue-green ribbons into her graying locks.

timeline.summary: Nimiroti, who no longer remembers her, tells Zimone she is someone she loves.
timeline.quote: I don't know who you are, but I know you're someone I love.

timeline.summary: Quint and four students search the tunnels beneath Strixhaven for the Invocation of the Founders.
timeline.quote: I wonder if the invocation will really slow the Phyrexian invasion, like Professor Vess said.

timeline.summary: The students climb into the Biblioplex and find it overrun by red sinew and the Invasion Tree, with the invocation's motes fighting the gloom.
timeline.quote: His lovely, luminous center of learning was gone.

timeline.summary: The students flee through the Biblioplex, fighting back with magic.
timeline.quote: They didn't even speak. They just ran.

timeline.summary: The students sneak through the Biblioplex avoiding patrolling professors, and Quint summons a statue spirit that shouts at a professor to save Zimone.
timeline.quote: No talking in the library!

timeline.summary: They find the Invocation of the Founders on a platform and discover it is partially alive and shields them from Phyrexian attention.
timeline.quote: It's protecting us from Phyrexian attention.

timeline.summary: Dina and Zimone build a ritual to blast a hole to open air, while a professor attacks and the invocation folds into a pocket-sized ball.
timeline.quote: he grabbed it and rammed it into his pocket, out of sight

timeline.summary: The ritual's overload turns the Biblioplex's bookcases into a huge tree that smashes through the ceiling.
timeline.quote: and kept growing , boughs forming a perfect helix of steps

timeline.summary: The students read the five petals of the invocation on the roof, describing Strixhaven's nature back to itself.
timeline.quote: They told Strixhaven what it was, and in that telling, there was no room for Phyrexia.

timeline.summary: Liliana finds Dina, Killian, Zimone and Rootha injured, and Killian digs out his father alive.
timeline.quote: but alive, and himself.

timeline.summary: Kaito meets Zimone, a Strixhaven student sent by Niv-Mizzet to wait for him.
timeline.quote: I'm Zimone. I'm a student? Quandrix College, at Strixhaven University.

timeline.summary: Zimone leads the group to a courtyard where Kaito presents Tyvar and Niko to the dragon Niv-Mizzet.
timeline.quote: The alley ended in a small courtyard, dominated by a massive red dragon lounging on the far side like a cat

timeline.summary: Zimone reports that Nashi's drones recorded a house with distorted space on the other side.
timeline.quote: Just a house, perfectly normal, if in need of a good cleaning service.

timeline.summary: The team takes Etrata's monitoring devices and files through the door into the House.
timeline.quote: One by one, the group filed inside.

timeline.summary: The party moves down a dusty hallway and discovers the door they came through has vanished.
timeline.quote: The door's gone

timeline.summary: Zimone realizes the room is not the one Nashi's drone recorded, so the House rearranges itself.
timeline.quote: This isn't the same room that it recorded.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer finds a family photo with the adults' faces scratched out and the daughter smiling.
timeline.quote: The faces of the adults had been scratched out, reduced to white scabs on the paper

timeline.summary: Niko proposes a right-hand search pattern, as in Theros labyrinth exercises, and leads the party.
timeline.quote: We take the right-hand turn and keep following to the right until and unless we wind up back where we started.

timeline.summary: The party finds an abandoned funfair in a cornfield beyond glass doors, but Zimone shows the sky is a glass ceiling, so it is still the House.
timeline.quote: If they were indoors, there could be no breeze, and without a breeze, why was it moving?

timeline.summary: A voice cries for help and Tyvar runs toward it; Zimone chases him.
timeline.quote: Tyvar's thin leash on his own heroic urges snapped, and he took off running

timeline.summary: Zimone races after Tyvar through the doorway as something shatters beside her head and the ballroom disappears.
timeline.quote: Something shattered on the doorway next to her head as she ran through

timeline.summary: Tyvar and Zimone find an empty hall with no one in danger and conclude the House is playing tricks.
timeline.quote: On the other side of the door was an empty hall.

timeline.summary: The doorway behind Tyvar and Zimone becomes a solid wall papered with moths, separating them from the others.
timeline.quote: where the doorway back to the ballroom should have been, was a wall

timeline.summary: Tyvar and Zimone discover their hallway has turned into a towering library when they stopped looking.
timeline.quote: They were no longer in a hallway.

timeline.summary: Tyvar turns his skin to wood and punches through the wall, finding a stairway beyond.
timeline.quote: Tyvar's skin rippled, taking on the hardwood sheen of the floor beneath his feet

timeline.summary: Zimone ties a fractal thread to Tyvar and stays in the library to study the books while he climbs the stairs.
timeline.quote: I'll keep the other one, and hopefully that means we won't lose each other.

timeline.summary: Tyvar's climb leads back into the same library, where Zimone waits.
timeline.quote: He was back in the library.

timeline.summary: Zimone and Tyvar remain in the library as Zimone researches.
timeline.quote: The library had remained a library, to Zimone's delight and Tyvar's disappointment.

timeline.summary: Zimone discovers the house was built by an architect who lived there with her family and has had many owners.
timeline.quote: the original architect lived here with her family, a long, long time ago

timeline.summary: Zimone reports the library focuses on occultism and entropy-based magic that may explain the House.
timeline.quote: mostly it's occultism and the kind of magic that makes Professor Vess recommend you rethink your academic goals.

timeline.summary: A ripping sound sounds nearby and the bookshelves begin to warp as a creature emerges.
timeline.quote: warping into strange, asymmetrical shapes

timeline.summary: Tyvar throws a marble bust at the creature's head to draw it from Zimone.
timeline.quote: He grabbed the closest of them, feeling the structure of the stone bleeding into his skin, and flung the bust as hard as he could at the creature's head.

timeline.summary: The creature pulls itself back together and rises again.
timeline.quote: The creature was pulling itself back together

timeline.summary: Tyvar and Zimone flee into the shadows of the library.
timeline.quote: together they turned and fled deeper into the library

timeline.summary: The creature stops pursuing Tyvar and Zimone, and they rest.
timeline.quote: The creature wasn't following them anymore.

timeline.summary: A translucent image of Dean Kianne emerges from the wall and tries to draw Zimone to her.
timeline.quote: what pulled itself free was not the spindly, terrible attacker, but an elegant elf woman

timeline.summary: The phantom claims she let Phyrexia take her to prove her theories on mana transformation.
timeline.quote: I let them take me, darling.

timeline.summary: Tyvar holds Zimone back and calls the phantom a trick.
timeline.quote: Why would she be trying to convince you to come to her?

timeline.summary: In a fateshifter vision, the creature's claw rips Tyvar open through the phantom's chest.
timeline.quote: slicing through skin and muscle with ease

timeline.summary: The vision breaks and Tyvar, clutching his fateshifter, realizes he must stand and fight.
timeline.quote: the moment shattered like the ice at a river's edge on a winter morning, leaving Tyvar gasping, one hand going to the fateshifter he had tucked into his belt

timeline.summary: Tyvar grabs the creature's wrist and turns his own body to plaster, matching its flesh.
timeline.quote: what looked like plaster began to crawl up his hands, engulfing his arms.

timeline.summary: Tyvar explains the camouflage makes them part of the House so its defenses ignore them.
timeline.quote: Until I release the magic, we are made of the House, and the House doesn't see us as invaders.

timeline.summary: Zimone and Tyvar find a room of carved doors and realize the House is setting lures in other places.
timeline.quote: it's setting lures in places where it might be able to attract more people.

timeline.summary: Tyvar begins to sound like the House, speaking of devouring the Multiverse, and Zimone's vision shows her becoming a small version of the creature.
timeline.quote: body breaking from the inside as it blossomed into a new, smaller version of the creature from before

timeline.summary: Zimone's fateshifter pulls her back and she begs Tyvar to release the camouflage.
timeline.quote: her fateshifter a burning coal against her skin

timeline.summary: The plaster bleeds from their skin and Tyvar apologizes.
timeline.quote: The plaster bled out of their skins until they were themselves again.

timeline.summary: Tyvar finds a tattered vest to help them look like part of the House.
timeline.quote: Tyvar rummaged around the nearest set of shelves, pulling out a tattered vest.

timeline.summary: Tyvar tells Zimone how he saw allies, Koma and the World Tree lost to Phyrexian transformation, and how he senses it to time his camouflage.
timeline.quote: Koma, who I had revered, whose favor I had sought, fell to that cruel transformation.

timeline.summary: Tyvar and Zimone find an impossible sunlit room where a teenage girl writes in a diary.
timeline.quote: Sunlight streamed through the two closed windows, bathing the teenage girl who sat on one of the larger couches

timeline.summary: Zimone realizes the girl repels the House and asks Tyvar to drop his camouflage.
timeline.quote: Whatever she is, she's repelling the House.

timeline.summary: Marina sees the strangers and screams; they introduce themselves.
timeline.quote: Marina Vendrell.

timeline.summary: Marina explains An Architectural Accounting, the book Zimone found, and admits to annotating it.
timeline.quote: That was started by the last person to live here.

timeline.summary: Marina denies the truth, chanting that they are not real, and the room erupts with nightmare beasts.
timeline.quote: You're not real, you're not here, you're not real, you're not here.

timeline.summary: The walls open and nightmare beasts crawl out as Tyvar drags Zimone away.
timeline.quote: the rest of the room began to warp and twist, the walls opening into holes from which crawled pustulant nightmare beasts

timeline.summary: Zimone reveals she grabbed Marina's diary.
timeline.quote: I got her diary

timeline.summary: Zimone concludes Valgavoth has swallowed the outside, leaving no plane beyond the House.
timeline.quote: I think at this point, mathematically speaking, Valgavoth is all.

timeline.summary: Zimone, transformed into a splintered-wood figure, cuts Niko free.
timeline.quote: its voice was Zimone's, and the figure was Zimone, somehow transformed like the wickerfolk

timeline.summary: Zimone uses Niv-Mizzet's box to trap a cultist in a cascade of geometric light.
timeline.quote: The box immediately spilled a geometric cascade of blue and green lines into the air.

timeline.summary: The team escapes through the door, with Kaito covering Tyvar against a nightmare.
timeline.quote: Together they ran for the door.

timeline.summary: The team steps out onto Ravnica.
timeline.quote: stepping with them out into the light of the Ravnican afternoon.

timeline.summary: Zimone, Tyvar and Niko go to Strixhaven.
timeline.quote: The others had gone with Zimone back to Strixhaven

timeline.summary: Zimone, struggling after graduation, sits in her bedroom with letters piled by her bed, including one from Tyvar inviting her on an adventure.
timeline.quote: Zimone stares at them, counting four letters in the stack.

timeline.summary: Zimone lifts the glamour on her bedroom to reveal her illusory map of the Multiverse and refuses to leave the house.
timeline.quote: An immense illusory map overtakes the entirety of the tiny space.

timeline.summary: Zimone notices a shadow above Arcavios in her model that does not look like Duskmourn's spread.
timeline.quote: A shadow.

timeline.summary: A letter arrives from Niv-Mizzet's office offering Zimone an apprenticeship and demanding a reply within twenty-four hours.
timeline.quote: The Omenpath Project awaits your response to the offer of apprenticeship.

timeline.summary: Zimone decides to split herself so she can do both the apprenticeship and her research.
timeline.quote: But what if … what if she could do both?

timeline.summary: After hours of failing at a duplication spell, Zimone accidentally divides herself and creates the Apprentice.
timeline.quote: Her double, dressed in white, wisps of blue magic still encircling her like morning fog, blinks back in surprise.

timeline.summary: Flashback: after Duskmourn Zimone returns to Strixhaven with Niko and Tyvar to report to Dean Nev.
timeline.quote: After Duskmourn, Zimone returned to Strixhaven.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Dean Nev says the Firemind does not recommend further study of Duskmourn's spread, and Zimone panics.
timeline.quote: the Firemind does not recommend pursuing study at the moment.

timeline.summary: The Apprentice returns from her first weeks of work, and with rent short, Zimone creates a second double, the Overachiever.
timeline.quote: Zimone seizes the feeling and pulls with her magic

timeline.summary: Zimone's two doubles irritate her, and she tracks the shadow, learning it is a solid thing mirrored above Arcavios that is not a second Duskmourn.
timeline.quote: Because the shadow in her model isn't a shadow.

timeline.summary: Zimone makes a third double, Friend Zimone, for company, who proves insufferable but proposes duplicating the model.
timeline.quote: Zimone emerges with bags under her eyes and a duplicate in a red sweater behind her.

timeline.summary: Zimone, with Friend Zimone's help, realizes someone is duplicating the Multiverse.
timeline.quote: "Someone is duplicating the Multiverse."

timeline.summary: Zimone panics when her flat grows warm and the window is found closed, then Dina knocks on the door.
timeline.quote: She half-gasps, half-sobs, and bruises her knuckles diving over the bed to open it again.

timeline.summary: Zimone rants about Friend Zimone to Dina, who gently points out that the double is Zimone herself.
timeline.quote: "Hey. That's you."

timeline.summary: Zimone realizes she cannot be everything, and decides to just be herself for a while.
timeline.quote: "I can't be everything. I think I need to just be me for a while."

timeline.summary: Zimone reintegrates her doubles and resigns from the extra jobs.
timeline.quote: Their forms turn to vapor, the vapor disappears

timeline.summary: Zimone shows Dina her model, and they trace the duplicate's caster by spell, which points to Chandra Nalaar.
timeline.quote: "Oh, damn, she's famous," she says, pointing at the image. "Chandra Nalaar.

timeline.summary: Zimone closes her window and agrees to take Dina's offer of a place to stay.
timeline.quote: She walks to the window and closes it.

timeline.summary: Zimone graduates from Quandrix and begins a fellowship on Ravnica.
timeline.quote: graduated from Quandrix and has begun a new fellowship on Ravnica

timeline.summary: Zimone summons Primo, then refuses to unsummon him after returning from Duskmourn.
timeline.quote: she found herself unwilling to unsummon him

relations.quote: She's not for you to harm
You've been absent from my classes for weeks
hiding behind Tyvar, who stood his ground

relations.note: Drags her to safety from the beasts.
relations.quote: He ran, pulling her with him.
Her roommate, Abatha, is at the door
Anyone who messes with Zimone messes with Primo!

pages_say.description: A prodigy who earned early admission to Strixhaven, chooses Quandrix, and receives mysterious packages of ribbons from her grandmother Nimiroti.
A Quandrix student who contributes growth theory to Dina's ritual and worries about her grandmother Nimiroti.
A Quandrix student from Strixhaven working with the Izzet League on a thesis about extraplanar spaces; she guides Kaito to Niv-Mizzet and joins the team as researcher.
A Strixhaven researcher with a monitor who conjures fractal light and is drawn to the House's library.
A Strixhaven researcher who studies the House's library and learns the house was built long ago by an architect.
A Quandrix student carrying books who survives with Tyvar by hiding as part of the House and sees a vision of her own transformation.
A Quandrix student who reads Marina's diary and deduces that Valgavoth has swallowed the outside.
A Quandrix student who, transformed into a splintered wood figure, frees Niko and uses Niv-Mizzet's math box as a weapon.
A Quandrix graduate living in a Ravnican apartment, traumatized by Duskmourn, who divides herself into doubles to cope with work and her research on a shadow above Arcavios.
A mathematical prodigy and Duskmourn survivor who graduated from Quandrix and begins a fellowship on Ravnica.
Someone who gave Chandra and Ajani a destination.
